name: Juanes World Tour
description: Don't miss the chance to see Colombian rock superstar Juanes light up the Super Bock Arena. Expect an unforgettable night of Latin rock hits and high-energy performance as part of his celebrated world tour.
longDescription:
Juanes, the Grammy Award-winning Colombian musician, brings his World Tour to Porto. Known for his distinctive blend of rock, pop, and traditional Latin American sounds, Juanes has achieved international recognition with hits like "A Dios le Pido" and "La Camisa Negra." His career spans decades, marked by a consistent output of critically acclaimed albums and a reputation for energetic live performances.

Attendees can expect a concert experience featuring a selection of Juanes' extensive discography. The performance will take place at the Super Bock Arena, a large-scale indoor venue designed for major musical acts. The atmosphere will be characterized by the artist's engagement with the audience and the presentation of his signature musical style.

The event is scheduled for July 26, 2026. Ticketing information and availability can be checked through official vendor channels. The Super Bock Arena is located within walking distance of the Casa da Música metro station, served by multiple lines.
